_comment: X-tee (Estonian X-Road) production member identifiers (#718), cached from the public X-tee subsystem catalogue https://x-tee.ee/catalogue-data/EE/index.json (served to https://x-tee.ee/catalogue/EE). The catalogue carries no organisation names; for memberClass GOV the memberCode is the organisation's registrikood, so an institution's X-tee member identifier is EE/GOV/<registrikood> when that code is listed here. Subsystem lists are kept for provenance only.
